dogecoin.text: We don't need a crypto leader. A crypto leader is actually very anti-crypto. A "dogecoin dominant" scenario means its Elon's game now and thats something that everyone who loves crypto should be strongly against. 2/2

Just sold 100% of my #dogecoin and will never buy again. Not because I'm convinced its a bad investment, but out of principle. In crypto the only way an asset goes up in value is if people buy into it, which means @elonmusk becomes a leader in crypto only if people allow it. 1/2
